Can include file names use variables?

answer_card.title: Includes: dynamic reuse
answer_card.answer_md: Includes are processed **at runtime** when reached, so earlier task results can affect them (like handlers, they may or may not run). Their main advantage is **looping**: an included file or role runs once per loop item. File names are templated, and you can pass variables in.
